prompt-system.title: How to write Seedance video prompts
prompt-system.description: Describe the subject, what changes, the camera movement and the timing. Add dialogue or sound only when the chosen model supports it. Start with a short test, then revise the parts you can observe.
prompt-system.spine_label: A useful shot has a spine
prompt-system.spine_description: Subject first. Then the move, timing and sound that make the direction legible to the model.
prompt-system.spine_note: Keep each beat observable. If the action cannot be seen, it is difficult to evaluate or revise.

prompt.title: Move
prompt.description: Slow dolly-in as warm practical light catches the product edge.

prompt.title: Resolve
prompt.description: A hand enters frame, stops beside the control dial; restrained room tone.

tips: Describe what changes; reference images already define what is visible.
Put spoken dialogue in double quotes when audio is enabled.
Test motion at 480p and short duration before the final render.

faq.title: Seedance AI FAQ
faq.description: Answers grounded in the settings and behavior available in the current product.

items.title: What is Seedance AI on this website?
items.description: SeedanceAI.dev is an independent video workspace using third-party API access. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ByteDance, Doubao or Dreamina.

items.title: Can I use Seedance 2.5 here?
items.description: Seedance 2.5 is selectable in this workspace. Review the current settings and credit charge before submitting; an account with enough credits is required.

items.title: Is Seedance 2.5 free here?
items.description: Eligible new accounts with verified email receive 5 credits, enough for one 5-second 480p Seedance 2.0 Mini video. Disposable addresses and repeat accounts on the same network within 24 hours are restricted. Seedance 2.5 uses 30 credits for that configuration; see the free-access guide and credit plans.

items.title: How much does a Seedance 2.5 video cost?
items.description: A 5-second video uses 30 credits at 480p or 60 at 720p. Packs currently start at $9.9. Dollar estimates per video depend on the plan, configuration and use of its credits.

items.title: What durations and resolutions can I choose?
items.description: Seedance 2.5 currently offers 5, 8, 10, 15 and 30-second options at 480p or 720p here. Seedance 2.0 offers 5, 8, 10 and 15-second options. These describe this product, not every provider.

items.title: Which references can I upload?
items.description: Seedance image-to-video accepts up to two images here. Image-reference mode accepts up to six images. This browser workspace does not currently provide video or audio reference uploads.

items.title: Is Seedance 2.5 unlimited here?
items.description: This workspace uses product credits per task. The unlimited comparison explains other providers’ time windows, queues and plan limits; it is not an unlimited offer from this site.

items.title: What happens if a generation fails?
items.description: Provider-confirmed failed tasks follow the credit-return process. A task that is still queued or processing is not treated as failed. Keep the task record and avoid duplicate submissions while it is running.

items.title: Can I use the videos commercially?
items.description: Commercial use depends on your plan, current provider and model terms, and rights to your inputs and requested content. Access to a model does not clear third-party characters, brands, music or likenesses.
